original_statement:
What did you do? List the exact steps to reproduce, in order. env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py line 51 sets _DEFAULT_STATE_DIR = ~/deployments/armada-fixturenet-e12/data/armada_env and, as user rix on the host, reads manifest.json, deployer.key and group-pubkey.json there, writes group-pubkey.json if missing, and runs the reconciler on the host against that directory. Run 'python3 env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py match' as rix: it cannot read the root-only directory.
What did you expect to happen? The gate's logic runs inside a laconic-so job (stack/compose-jobs, registered in the stack, mounting armada_env:/env, code from the env image) that takes the case (match or mismatch) and prints the same one-line JSON; env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py becomes a thin runner that runs the job through 'laconic-so deployment --dir <deployment> run-job' (syncing the deployment's job files with laconic-so's 'deploy create --update', as scripts/run-armada-watchtower-scenario.sh does) and prints the job's JSON unchanged. Checks: 1) Behavior: 'python3 env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py match' prints JSON with config_uses_keyfile_param = true, onchain_key_matches_file = true, manifest_records_key = true, overall_positive_case_passed = true. 2) Behavior: 'python3 env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py mismatch' prints JSON with verify_exit_code != 0 and failure_names_mismatch = true. 3) grep_absent: patterns 'armada_env', 'sudo', 'chmod' and 'chown' in env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py. 4) grep_absent: patterns '/home/' and '.worktrees/' in the new job's compose file.
What actually happened? Include the exact error text or output. verify.py reads and writes files under the deployment's data directory as a host process, so it fails with a permission error now that the directory is root-only.
Which surface or component? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py (E14b, arn-3ef)
What environment and version? (OS, app/gateway build or commit, network) armada-nitro main 564ef7f; fixturenet E12 (~/deployments/armada-fixturenet-e12, compose) whose data/ tmpfs is root-only (mode 0700, f149321); env image cerc/armada-nitro-env:local
Is it reproducible? (always / intermittently / once) — and how often. always
What is the impact / severity? Who is blocked and how badly? The E14b custodian gate fails on every run since the deployment's data directory was made root-only; any gate re-run or base replay that includes it is red.
What activity was underway when this was found? (ODC Activity — e.g. testing, code review, normal usage, reproduction attempt) operational use: checking landed gates against the root-only data directory (f149321)
What condition or event exposed the defect? (ODC Trigger — e.g. a config change, concurrent access, a boundary/edge-case input, an unusual workload) the deployment data tmpfs became mode 0700 (root-only)
restatement: The hub-custodian-frost gate today runs as a host process. It reads and writes files directly under the deployment's armada_env data directory at ~/deployments/armada-fixturenet-e12/data/armada_env. That directory is now root-only (mode 0700). The gate fails with a permission error on every run because of this. The fix moves the gate's check logic into a laconic-so job that runs inside a container. The container mounts the armada_env volume at /env and runs code from the env image. The job is registered in the stack under stack/compose-jobs. env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py becomes a thin runner: it first syncs the deployment's job files with laconic-so's 'deploy create --update' (the same step scripts/run-armada-watchtower-scenario.sh takes), then runs the job through 'laconic-so deployment --dir <deployment> run-job', then prints the job's JSON output unchanged. After the fix, the match case must still print the same four passing fields, and the mismatch case must still print a failing verify_exit_code and a true failure_names_mismatch field. verify.py itself must no longer read or write the state directory or escalate privileges. The new job's compose file must name no host-specific or worktree-specific path.

restatement_clauses.text: The check's logic runs inside a laconic-so job registered in the stack under stack/compose-jobs, not as a host process.
The job mounts armada_env:/env and runs code from the env image.
verify.py becomes a thin runner that syncs the deployment's job files with laconic-so's 'deploy create --update' (as scripts/run-armada-watchtower-scenario.sh does) before running the job.
verify.py runs the check through 'laconic-so deployment --dir <deployment> run-job' and prints the job's JSON output unchanged.

Running 'python3 env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py match' prints JSON with config_uses_keyfile_param = true, onchain_key_matches_file = true, manifest_records_key = true, overall_positive_case_passed = true.
Running 'python3 env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py mismatch' prints JSON with verify_exit_code != 0 and failure_names_mismatch = true.
env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py contains none of the patterns 'armada_env', 'sudo', 'chmod', and 'chown'.
The new job's compose file contains none of the patterns '/home/' and '.worktrees/'.

goal: Move the hub-custodian-frost gate's check logic out of the host process and into a laconic-so container job, so the gate works again now that the deployment's data directory is root-only, with verify.py reduced to a thin runner over that job.
acceptance_criteria: The stack's job list (stack/stacks/armada-nitro-fixturenet/stack.yml) names a custodian-frost job.
The new custodian-frost job's compose file mounts the shared armada_env data at /env.
The new custodian-frost job's compose file runs the cerc/armada-nitro-env image.
env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py passes the --update flag when it syncs the deployment before the job runs.

Running the match check prints one line of JSON. The JSON reports the config takes the group key from a file, the on-chain key matches that file, the manifest records the key, and the overall positive case passed.
Running the mismatch check prints one line of JSON. The JSON reports a non-zero verify exit code and a true failure_names_mismatch field.
env/gates/hub-custodian-frost/verify.py contains none of the words armada_env, sudo, chmod, or chown.
The new custodian-frost job's compose file names no path under /home/ or .worktrees/.
